youtube.description:
Claude prompt trick: add one line so Claude asks you 3 questions before it answers, and the plan fits you.

Claude prompt trick: make it ask you 3 questions first. Copy the line. Works on every plan.

1. Goal - State your goal, like starting a YouTube channel.
2. Add - Add: before you start, ask me three questions.
3. Answer - Reply with your budget, audience, and deadline.
4. Result - Get a plan that fits you, not a generic one.

Needs: All plans
